title: HyperMachine sandbox request, version 1
description: One sandboxed run: a command and what contains it. Read by `hm sandbox exec` and by hv2_sandbox::request::Request. A field not listed here is an error.

command.description: The program, then its arguments. Run directly, never through a shell.

env.description: The workload's whole environment. Nothing is inherited.

workingDir.description: Where it starts. Absent, the backend chooses.

stdin.description: Text written to its standard input.

limits.description: Ceilings on what it consumes. Each is unlimited when absent.

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock time before it is killed.

egress.description: deny: no network at all. host: the host's network, unrestricted.

root.description: A directory that becomes its root, hiding the host's. With one, readOnly and readWrite paths are mounted in it; readWrite is refused where that cannot be done, which is everywhere but Linux.

readOnly.description: Absolute, existing paths it may read, with everything under them.

readWrite.description: Absolute, existing paths it may read and write, with everything under them.

denied.description: Absolute, existing paths closed to it, with everything under them, whatever else would let it in. A readOnly or readWrite path under one is an error.

confine.description: Whether readOnly and readWrite are all of the caller's filesystem it reaches. False, they only open paths its containment would hide.

isolateProcesses.description: Hide the host's processes from it.

bestEffort.description: Run with whatever of this the host can enforce and report what was dropped. The default refuses.
